name: Abstract-role transfer
description: Current relation pattern → analogous earlier role mapping. Favor the same role rather than the same surface token.
provenance: Authored illustrative seeds; not learned or extracted.

examples.description: Mira gives Nia cup; Theo gives Omar map; ask recipient.
Bird carries twig; child carries rope; ask carrier.
Nia lends Theo key; Omar lends Mira book; ask lender.
Door opened with key; crate opened with crowbar; ask instrument.
Mira follows Nia; Theo follows Omar; ask leader.
Same names occur with reversed giver/recipient roles.
Passive sentence reverses surface order but preserves agent.
One frame lacks a required role.
Two roles can align equally well.
Analogy proposes an entity absent from the second frame.

required_program: Align relational frame roles across examples using variable bindings and type constraints, distinguishing role transfer from surface-token copying.
